modern_source: CMWF 2023 IHP Survey (Q9 distribution published in CIHI data tables)
modern_definition: % of adults who got a same- or next-day appointment the last time they were sick/needed care, excl. those who did not need to make an appointment
change_vs_2018: Same survey series and base (excl. did-not-need); 2023 wording includes telephone/video appointments and excludes ED; value re-based from published response distribution (CMWF has no 10-country published table with this base). 2023 survey mixed mode (phone in most; mostly online in SWE, CHE, USA; ~half online in GBR; registry/ABS samples in SWE/CHE/USA) vs telephone-only 2016.
notes: CMWF base verified against Health Foundation 2023 values (NLD 50, DEU 49, GBR 42) and CMWF 2020 toplines. CIHI's published values (e.g. CAN 26, NLD 54) use narrower base excl. never able/not sure. 2020 toplines (AUS 65, CAN 38, FRA 53, DEU 75, NLD 66, SWE 33, CHE 53, GBR 52, USA 49) show a large drop to 2023. Mirror Mirror 2024 measure 7 is same-day among all adults (not comparable).

modern_source: CMWF 2023 IHP Survey (Q15 distribution published in CIHI data tables)
modern_definition: % of adults who saw/needed a specialist in past 2 years who waited 2 months or longer for the appointment
change_vs_2018: Same question & base; value = sum of published categories '2 months to <1 year' + '1 year or more'. 2023 survey mixed mode (phone in most; mostly online in SWE, CHE, USA; ~half online in GBR; registry/ABS samples in SWE/CHE/USA) vs telephone-only 2016.
notes: Large increases vs 2016 (e.g. DEU 3 -> 23, GBR 19 -> 42) partly reflect real deterioration and possibly mode change. Mirror Mirror 2024 uses 'waited <1 week' instead.

change_vs_2018: Same composite and self-rated income-vs-national-average grouping ('somewhat/much below' vs 'somewhat/much above').
